products.name: Green Coffee Allocation Board
products.product: A focused green coffee lot allocation tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: small specialty coffee roasters serving wholesale and direct customers
products.problem: Contracted coffee, landed stock, sample approvals, roast plans, blends, wholesale commitments, and projected depletion live in separate forecasts.
products.valueProposition: Turns green coffee lot allocation tracking into a visible operating queue so every roast commitment is tied to an available approved lot or a documented substitution decision.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets green coffee lot allocation tracking software, green coffee lot allocation tracking tracker, green coffee lot allocation tracking template, and green coffee lot allocation tracking checklist searches.

products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
